correctness.rationale: Represent uniform normal direction in H by centered independent standard Gaussians. The exposed maximizer is the allowed edge with largest absolute coordinate difference. If the extreme pair is allowed it wins; if it is forbidden, matching disjointness ensures exactly the two second-extreme candidate edges are allowed and one wins according to exchangeable top/bottom extreme spacings, each with probability 1/2. Conditional rank-label counting adds 1/[n(n-1)(n-2)] for each matched endpoint to the undirected edge probability 2/[n(n-1)], and orientation halves it. Multiplicities count allowable edges among unmatched/matched vertices and sum angles to 1. Boundary m=0, perfect matching m=n/2, and missing levels handled. I independently enumerated all labeled Gaussian rank permutations with rational tie probabilities for n=4..8 and every admissible matching size, reproducing individual exposure probabilities and global normalization; this finite corroboration is not the all-n proof.
residual_risks: Finite independent enumerations/numerical examples only corroborate explicitly identified analytic or exhaustive-finite arguments; they do not prove unbounded statements.
